l2882.title: dialog 2882-2897
lines_to_bind: locale:2882 [quest_dialog | - | -] "Alright girls, welcome to auditions! I hope you're all excited to be here."
locale:2883 [quest_dialog | - | -] "I'd just like each of you to pick a part that was previously played by Tyra and show me how you would act it out."
locale:2884 [quest_dialog | - | -] "Okay then, let's start with you Joelle. Show us what you've got!"
locale:2885 [quest_dialog | - | -] 'So this man once asked me, why do you care so much about this stinkin sunflower?'
locale:2886 [quest_dialog | - | -] 'I was confounded. How do you explain to someone the very origin of your existence? Besides, the sunflower was at least three times the size of this guy.'
locale:2887 [quest_dialog | - | -] 'But before I could explain, he actually tried to chop down the sunflower! As you can imagine, the fifty fairies that swarmed him sure ruined his day!'
locale:2888 [quest_dialog | - | -] 'Alright, not bad, Joelle! What about you, Tarvie?'
locale:2889 [quest_dialog | - | -] 'No, Mira! How could you have done such a thing?! The sunflowers and the rainbow are the essence of life itself!'
locale:2890 [quest_dialog | - | -] "If there's no light, then - er -- then..."
locale:2891 [quest_dialog | - | -] 'Then how are the sunflowers to survive? Think about someone other than yourself for once!'
locale:2892 [quest_dialog | - | -] 'Not bad, Tarvie, but you should make sure you know your lines by heart before auditioning!'

lines_to_bind: locale:37875 [npc_dialog | Memorial Caverns | Dego Riva] "The eight murals you'll see today were painted by the pixie master painter, Dego Riva. "

locale:37878 [npc_dialog | - | Gleam Council] 'The Gleam Council had many clever and powerful members. Some of the Council members were too old, too impatient, or too inexperienced, but all were concerned wi'
locale:37879 [npc_dialog | - | -] "Follow me, and we'll head over to the second mural."

locale:37880 [npc_dialog | - | Gleam Council] 'This mural represents conflict within the Gleam Council. Some leaders believed people were happiest when they were free. Others believed the sacrifice of freedo'

locale:37881 [npc_dialog | - | Gleam Council] 'Fierce arguments over the use of magic began to disrupt many Council meetings. Only a few people noticed when certain Council members stopped attending meetings'
locale:37882 [npc_dialog | - | Gloam Council] 'We now know they were meeting in secret. They had formed the Gloam Council.'

locale:37883 [npc_dialog | - | Gloam Council] 'Most of what happened is lost to history now. The Gloam Council was secretive, hidden in shadow. We know they believed that our world and people are infused wit'

locale:37884 [npc_dialog | - | Artifact] 'You see, magic exists in everything around us, and we are all partly magical creatures. The Gloam figured out that they could control everyone by making an Arti'

locale:37885 [npc_dialog | - | Gloam Council] 'The Gloam Council started building a powerul Artifact that would control magic... and thus control every person in the world. A few brave Gloam Council members '
locale:37886 [npc_dialog | - | -] "Let's move to the fourth mural."

locale:37887 [npc_dialog | - | Gleam Council] 'The Gleam Council helped every race seek shelter, to avoid being controlled by the Artifact. The humans sailed away. The dwarves ventured deep into their mounta'

locale:37888 [npc_dialog | - | Snowhill] 'The elves fled north after raising a magic crystal barrier, that is still standing near Snowhill. Although some dwarves and humans have returned to Sacred Grove'

locale:37889 [npc_dialog | - | Artifact] "Not everyone took shelter, though. A few people of every race simply couldn't get out in time. Others wanted to stay and defend their homes. And a small group o"

locale:37890 [npc_dialog | - | Artifact] 'It takes tremendous power to create a device to control all of the magic. The heroes knew the destroying the Artifact might release that power into the world. T'

locale:37891 [npc_dialog | - | The Unbinding] 'The heroes destroyed the Artifact in an act now called The Unbinding. A massive wave of pure power washed over the land, decimating everything in its path. Now,'
locale:37892 [npc_dialog | - | -] 'The races who fled or went underground were safe. The pixies lived in these caverns for a long time. '
locale:37893 [npc_dialog | Sanctuary | Queen Ayani] 'Every few years, a few adventurers would head up to the surface to check, but the world was barren and lifeless.'

locale:37894 [npc_dialog | Sanctuary | Queen Ayani] 'One day, a strange new kind of pixie came into the caverns. He had lost his wings, and it looked like he had somehow merged with other creatures. He told a tale'

locale:37895 [npc_dialog | Sanctuary | Queen Ayani] 'The great pixie Queen Ayani met with this strange pixie. She discovered that pixies who did not take shelter were forever changed by the Unbinding. These are wh'
locale:37896 [npc_dialog | Sanctuary | -] 'Please follow me to the next mural.'

locale:37897 [npc_dialog | Sanctuary | Queen Ayani] 'Queen Ayani was a child during the Cataclysm. She still remembered how beautiful the world was before the Unbinding. The plight of the Changelings, and the dest'

locale:37898 [npc_dialog | Sanctuary | Queen Ayani] 'Against the wishes of her companions, Queen Ayani went to the surface to see for herself what had become of her world. When she saw the devastation, she began t'

locale:37899 [npc_dialog | Sanctuary | Queen Ayani] 'As Ayani cried, her tears began to form rivers. Where the rivers touched, new life began to form and our world began to heal. The pixies gradually returned to t'
locale:37900 [npc_dialog | Sanctuary | -] "Let's go see the last mural."

locale:37901 [npc_dialog | Sanctuary | Queen Ayani] 'Ayani never again left that place. It was the founding of our current capital city, which she named Sanctuary in memory of the sheltering caverns below. When Ay'
